messages:
Aisha Chen: FYI, incoming security questionnaire from HelioFin — they attached a small SIG-lite + a separate KMS/crypto appendix. They're asking specifically about BYOK, HSM support, and rotation windows. POC deadline is next Tue. Can we please triage and assign?
Ben Laurent: Ack. Can you drop the docs here? Also need to know whether the POC will use Hosted API or Dedicated capacity — that changes the KMS answers.
Aisha Chen: Uploaded: https://files.redwood/heliofin/SIG-lite.pdf and https://files.redwood/heliofin/crypto-appendix.pdf . Sales notes say they want Dedicated for data isolation but open to Host if BYOK is supported quickly.
Marco Rivera: Assigned to me for the questionnaire answers. Quick questions: 1) Do they require FIPS 140-2 HSM integration or just KMS envelope keys? 2) Any special compliance mapping (SOC2, PCI in scope)?
Aisha Chen: They flagged SOC2 + regional data residency (EU). No PCI. They prefer FIPS/HSM if we support it during POC.
Priya Nair: For Dedicated we can support customer-managed keys via our KMS connector, but HSM-backed BYOK is only available on Private (VPC) deployments today. For Hosted we offer envelope encryption with our KMS; BYOK via partner KMS requires extra setup.
Marco Rivera: Okay. I'll answer the SIG with the current product limitations and propose two flows: (A) Dedicated + Redwood-managed KMS (fast) or (B) Private/VPC + HSM BYOK (longer, enterprise setup).
Samira Patel: Legal: we'll need a narrow NDA addendum for key custody details before sharing implementation guides. @Aisha can we get HelioFin to sign the addendum?
Aisha Chen: On it — sending addendum now.
Marco Rivera: ETA: I can produce draft answers for the SIG parts and the crypto appendix by EOD tomorrow if the addendum is signed and the infra contacts confirm Dedicated vs Private. I will call out any gaps that require eng changes.
Priya Nair: If Marco needs sample config, paste this: 
```
redwood.kms.connector: aws-kms
encryption.mode: envelope
rotation.days: 90
byok.supported: false (hosted) / true (private)
```
Will confirm exact flag names once Marco says which path.
Ben Laurent: Sounds good. Q for Marco: mark any items that must be escalated to infra with "BLOCKER" so we can track.
Marco Rivera: Will do. I'll create a Jira ticket and link it here.
jira-bot: Created RED-1427: heliofin - SIG + crypto appendix intake (owner: Marco Rivera) — https://jira.redwood/RED-1427 — status: Open
Aisha Chen: Great, thanks. HelioFin deadline is Tue EOD; I'll push for the addendum and confirm Dedicated vs Private by tomorrow morning.
Ben Laurent: Thx. If Dedicated confirmed, timeline likely ok. If they insist on HSM BYOK for Hosted, that'll be a multi-week engineering work item — flag as risk. :warning:
Aisha Chen: Noted. I'll update HelioFin and loop infra/legal as needed. :thumbsup:
